title: Auto-Optimize Pipeline
description: Build the full auto-optimization pipeline that chains all 5 panels into a single-click workflow: analyze setup (material, tools, machine) -> optimize all operations (physics advisory for each) -> enhance NC output (PPP per-block S/F) -> generate quality package (FAI + setup sheet). The 'PRISM Auto-Optimize' toolbar button runs the entire pipeline with progress tracking and produces a comprehensive report.

forge_triple.hook: hm-plugin:auto-optimize-pre-validation — BUILT (validates all prerequisites before pipeline run)
forge_triple.skill: /hypermill-auto-optimize — BUILT (one-click full optimization of hyperMILL job)

sessions.title: Pipeline Orchestration + Setup Analysis
sessions.intent: Build the pipeline orchestrator that chains setup analysis, per-operation optimization, NC enhancement, and quality package generation into a single automated workflow with progress tracking.

units.title: Pipeline Orchestrator Engine
units.description: Build AutoOptimizePipelineEngine that orchestrates the 4-stage pipeline: (1) Setup Analysis: extract material, tools, machine from active hyperMILL job via AC API. (2) Per-Op Optimization: run PhysicsAdvisorEngine on each operation. (3) NC Enhancement: run PostEnhancerEngine on generated NC file. (4) Quality Package: run QualityGateEngine + FAI + setup sheet. Pipeline runs sequentially with progress callbacks (0-100%) and abort support.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Pipeline executes 4 stages sequentially with progress callback at each stage boundary
Setup analysis extracts material, tool list, and machine from active hyperMILL job
Abort support cancels pipeline cleanly at any stage with partial results preserved

units.title: Per-Operation Batch Optimization
units.description: Extend the pipeline to run physics advisory on all operations in the job (not just active one). Batch process: iterate through hyperMILL job list, extract cutting parameters per operation, run Kienzle+SLD+deflection, apply optimized S/F. Track per-operation results (improved/unchanged/flagged). Handle multi-setup jobs with WCS transitions. Support parallel processing for independent operations.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Batch processes all operations in job list with per-op status tracking
Multi-setup jobs handled correctly with WCS-aware parameter mapping
Operations flagged as 'already optimal' when delta < 2% are skipped (no regression)

units.title: Auto-Optimize Progress UI + Toolbar Button
units.description: Build the Auto-Optimize progress panel with: stage progress bar (4 stages), per-operation progress within each stage, real-time log of actions taken, estimated time remaining. Add 'PRISM Auto-Optimize' toolbar button that launches the pipeline. Add confirmation dialog showing job summary before starting.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Progress bar shows 4 stages with current stage highlighted and percentage complete
Per-operation log scrolls in real-time showing 'Op 3/12: Roughing - optimized S from 4500 to 5200'
Confirmation dialog shows job name, operation count, and estimated processing time before start

sessions.exit_gate: Pipeline runs 4 stages with progress + batch optimization processes all ops | omega_floor >= 0.90

sessions.title: Comprehensive Report + E2E Testing
sessions.intent: Build the comprehensive optimization report that summarizes all improvements, and write E2E tests for the full auto-optimize pipeline.

units.title: Comprehensive Optimization Report
units.description: Generate a comprehensive PDF report after auto-optimize completes. Report includes: executive summary (total cycle time saved, tool life improvement, quality score), per-operation detail table (before/after S/F, force delta, deflection status), quality assessment summary (Ra predictions, surface integrity status per op), and appendices (FAI plan, setup sheet, SLD charts). Report branded with PRISM logo.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: PDF report generates with executive summary showing aggregate cycle time and tool life deltas
Per-operation table shows before/after comparison for all S/F parameters
Appendices include generated FAI plan and setup sheet with physics annotations

units.title: Auto-Optimize E2E Integration Tests
units.description: Write E2E tests for the full auto-optimize pipeline using 3 representative test jobs: (1) Simple 3-axis prismatic part (4 operations), (2) 5-axis impeller channel (8 operations with multi-axis), (3) Hardened steel mold cavity (6 operations with surface integrity requirements). Verify each stage completes, report generates, and physics outputs are within reference tolerances.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: 3-axis test job: all 4 operations optimized with cycle time improvement > 0%
5-axis test job: multi-axis operations handled without SLD errors on rotary moves
Mold cavity test job: surface integrity flags correctly for finishing operations on >55 HRC

sessions.exit_gate: Report generates as PDF + 3 E2E test jobs pass all stages | omega_floor >= 0.90
